Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10287 - 1982 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HOLES FOR GENERAL FILING OF PAPER 



0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 31 August 1982, after the draft finalized by the Paper and its Products 
( Excluding Packaging Materials ) Sectional Committee had been approved 
by the Chemical Division Council. 

0,2 For an eflScient filing system, it is essential that the records are 
maintained in a neat manner and the time taken for filing papers is 
minimum. This is possible if the holes made in paper, for general filing, 
are specified with respect to their arrangement and dimensions. Further 
specification of these characteristics of holes, will aid in the manufacture of 
punches and files having compatible mechanisms. 

0.2.1 This standard is based on ISO 838-1974 'Paper holes for general 
filing purposes— Specifications', issued by the International Organization 
for Standardization. 

0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is comphed with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded ofi* 
value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions, spacing and position of the 
holes made in sheets of paper or documents, in order to permit their filing 
in ordinary files. 

1.1.1 This standard applies to sheets or documents like, correspondence, 
standards, thin documents, that can be perforated in an office with a 
simple punch. 

1.1.2 In general, it does not apply to sheets or documents like, loose leaf 
binders, special filing systems. 

♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( reviesd). 



IS : 10287 - 1982 

2. ARRANGEMENTS 

2.1 The holes shall be arranged symmetrically in relation to the axis of the 
sheet or the document, perpendicular to the line of the axis of the holes 
( see Fig. 1 ). 

Note — The axis of the holes shall be arranged parallel to the short or long edge 
of the sheet or the document, as required. 

3. DIMENSIONAL CHARACTERISTICS 

3.1 Distance between centres of holes shall be 80 ± 0*5 mm, diameter of 
holes shall be 6 ± 0*5 mm, and the distance from the centre of the holes to 
the nearest edge of the sheet shall be 12 ± I'O mm ( see Fig. 1 ). 



-12ti.o 



801-0-5 




All dimensions in millimetres. 

Fig. 1 Arrangement and Dimensional Characteristics
